planningAudit.notes: All18 actual claim-to-accepted-completion windows serviced current live gameplay: fresh context, normal-tree selection, approval and intervening progress/status commentary where it occurred. Reasoning/tool/scheduling/status overhead remains included; not isolated inference. Root pin/code review occurred before timer start; its later progress-sync request was handled between claims. No developer/code/report/ledger authoring or runtime tuning occurred within the fixed window. Observation waits were outside completed claims. No rejected or declined proposal was removed; none occurred in this live window. All startup idle and unserved scheduling gaps remain in whole-run totals.

planningLatency.meaning: Current claims end after successful validation/commit or explicit null decline. Rejected submissions remain inside the open claim through correction. Claim time includes reasoning/tools/scheduling/status commentary, not isolated inference.
planningLatency.requestLifetimeMeaning: Automatic request lifetime can begin before the measured window; the prepared owner already had one request pending before root review. That preparation lifetime is not measured thinking or idle. All actual claim windows remain included.

failureRate.denominator: Completed helper dispatch attempts = helper-verified completions + failed attempts; excludes passive effect steps and in-flight attempts.

failureCounting.note: Do not invent a category or successful outcome for a failed counter increment without routine_failed evidence. All failures remain in the completed-attempt rate.

episodeOutcomes.meaning: Only episode events captured within exact boundary, joined to private persisted action outcomes. No raw state/name/chat or private path is published.

comparison.baselineWholeRunCaveat: Immediate reliability baseline retains15 claimed-submission windows, including mixed support/gameplay claim1. Its separately audited subset excludes entire claim1. Current all18 claims are audited gameplay service; no current exclusion. Historical reports remain unchanged.
comparison.higherSkillAndWorkloadCaveat: Same character has higher starting skill levels. Adaptive inventory/target decisions and random resource success differ; this is an observed before/after session, not a randomized isolated controller-speed experiment.
comparison.primaryMeaning: Immediate previous reliability run is primary; retain whole/all-claim and any separately audited subset. Prior continuity is an additional historical comparator.

jointAssessment.note: Lower idle alone does not establish success; inspect helper ambiguity, action rate, failures and actual progress. Skill/workload/network differences remain.

operatorNotes: All runtime, capture/ledger/report tools and tests prepared and published before the measured window. Root preflight review occurs before timer start.
Standing ordinary-resource goal is approved explicitly; no wall-clock renewal. Finite proposal/action deadlines, cooldowns and bounded retry/backoff chunks remain.
Same owned account with higher skills; this cloud agent is planner through current tools. No second provider, synthetic thinking sleep, game-rate change or public chat.
Keep startup idle and any unserved scheduling gaps; a helper promise is ambiguous, not productive evidence.

The unchanged legacy no_approved_work_idle bucket describes no materialized active/queued routine, not absence of standing-goal authority; resource/backoff waits remain visible idle rather than being relabeled productive.
Initial startup planning/status/tool overhead is retained. The original standing goal was approved once; later actual agent plans omit continuation to preserve it rather than renewing authority.
After auto-cutoff, stop was requested and exact owned process identities were checked. No new/replacement account, no provider or public chat.

The first automatic planner request was born during readiness before root review; its full755071ms lifetime includes preparation. All actual planning claims remain timed only inside the fixed window. Initial72-tick/28.809s visible-idle stretch includes actual start/tool/status/initial plan handling, not discarded preparation.

No artificial >180s planner delay was inserted. Live evidence is one standing approval lasting the full session while genuine later plans omit continuation; the preflight virtual-clock test separately exercises181s of unserved planning. In-window request lifetimes and actual claim times are reported, not claimed as isolated inference.

Compared with reliability, routes moved into a different normal-tree area and starting skills were higher; gains are observed before/after, not causally isolated controller improvements. Helper ambiguity rose by94ticks (3.13percentage points) while progress ticks rose968→1060; a helper promise remains unproven work.
limitations: This cloud agent supplied plans with current tools; no second provider/API key or inaccessible Wartime identity was tested.
A standing tile, helper promise or no-XP tick alone does not establish idle/productivity. Hidden server work remains uncertain.
All-claim and whole-run measurements retain every failure, pause and mixed window; any gameplay-only audit excludes entire mixed windows, without invented developer durations.
Single character and 20-minute window do not prove unlimited autonomy, PvP ability or a causal timing result independent of higher skills/workload.
